doc:
# Basic — Bulk Reconstruction

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “bulk reconstruction”).

claims.name: when_bulk_operator_ryutakayanagi_surface
claims.statement: When bulk operator is on the Ryu-Takayanagi surface, reconstruction only depends on bulk-to-boundary correlator without requiring explicit bulk modular flow

claims.name: bulk_operators_entanglement_wedge_reconstructed
claims.statement: Bulk operators in the entanglement wedge can be reconstructed from low-energy operators localized in the boundary region using modular flow

claims.name: bulk_operators_entanglement_wedge_have
claims.statement: Bulk operators in the entanglement wedge have natural boundary dual operators with fixed modular frequency, with smearing function determined by modular Hamiltonian kernel convolution

claims.name: when_bulk_geometry_ads_cft
claims.statement: When the bulk geometry in AdS/CFT contains a black hole, boundary subregions may be sufficient to reconstruct bulk operators if and only if the black hole microstate is known

sources.title: Learning the Alpha-bits of Black Holes

claims.name: ads_cft_provides_global_map
claims.statement: AdS/CFT provides a global map from bulk to boundary states, requiring construction of local recovery maps for entanglement wedge reconstruction

sources.title: Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction via Universal Recovery Channels

claims.name: ads_cft_bulk_operators_reconstructed
claims.statement: In AdS/CFT, bulk operators can be reconstructed in boundary region $A$ only if the state of the black hole is known, but no single boundary operator works for all microstates

sources.title: Learning the Alpha-bits of Black Holes

claims.name: operators_bulk_region_recovered_boundary
claims.statement: Operators in a bulk region $C$ can be recovered from a boundary region $A$ if and only if $C$ is included in the entanglement wedge $E_A$ of $A$.

sources.title: Holographic duality from random tensor networks

claims.name: bulk_operator_given_boundary_regions
claims.statement: A bulk operator in a given boundary region's entanglement wedge can be expressed as the response of the boundary region's modular Hamiltonian to a perturbation of the bulk state

sources.title: Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction via Universal Recovery Channels

claims.name: bulk_operators_entanglement_wedge_written
claims.statement: Bulk operators in the entanglement wedge can be written in a basis where the modular extrapolate dictionary acts naturally

claims.name: correlation_functions_bulk_operators_computed
claims.statement: Correlation functions of bulk operators can be computed from boundary reconstructions of individual operators with error bounded by $\frac{1}{2} \epsilon n(3n-1) \prod_i \|\phi_i\|$

sources.title: Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction via Universal Recovery Channels

claims.name: any_bulk_operator_lying_between
claims.statement: Any bulk operator lying between two minimal surfaces can be reconstructed as a boundary operator for any subspace of black-hole microstates of dimension $d<e^{\alpha S}$ where $S=\mathcal{A}_{0}/4G_{N}$ is the Bekenstein–Hawking entropy and $\alpha=\dfrac{\mathcal{A}_{2}-\mathcal{A}_{1}}{\mathcal{A}_{0}}$

sources.title: Learning the Alpha-bits of Black Holes

claims.name: ads_cft_any_causal_wedge
claims.statement: In AdS/CFT, any causal wedge $\mathcal{W}_C[A]$ that contains the locations of the bulk fields $\phi_i(x)$ used in defining the code subspace $\mathcal{H}_{\mathcal{C}}$ admits, via AdS-Rindler reconstruction, a set of operators $\phi_{A,i}(x)$ with support only on $A$ whose action on $\mathcal{H}_{\mathcal{C}}$ is the same as that of $\phi_i(x)$.

sources.title: Bulk Locality and Quantum Error Correction in AdS/CFT

claims.name: show_bulk_operators_lying_between
claims.statement: We show that bulk operators lying between the outermost extremal surface and the asymptotic boundary admit a simple boundary reconstruction in the classical limit.

sources.title: A World without Pythons would be so Simple

claims.name: rindler_wedge_reconstruction_achieved_using
claims.statement: Rindler wedge reconstruction can be achieved using recovery formula and global HKLL with bulk operators expressed as mode expansions on the Rindler wedge

sources.title: Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction via Universal Recovery Channels

claims.name: explicit_formulas_bulk_operators_require
claims.statement: Explicit formulas for bulk operators require complete understanding of bulk modular flow action

claims.name: onesided_bulk_reconstruction_access_interior
claims.statement: The one-sided bulk reconstruction can access the interior region of the black hole

sources.title: Expanding the Black Hole Interior: Partially Entangled Thermal States in SYK

claims.name: boundary_operator_computed_response_boundary
claims.statement: The boundary operator can be computed as the response of the boundary modular Hamiltonian to a perturbation in the direction of the bulk operator

sources.title: Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction via Universal Recovery Channels

claims.name: bulk_reconstruction_ads_cft_necessarily
claims.statement: Bulk reconstruction in AdS/CFT is necessarily only approximate, with non-perturbative lower bounds on the error

sources.title: Learning the Alpha-bits of Black Holes
